Wedding & intimate moments photography

Moments that pass cannot be relived.

But the way they felt deserves to be remembered.

Explore my work ↗
01 / The philosophy

It's never just about how it looked. It's about how it felt.

The quiet glances. The unplanned laughter. The little moments in between. I believe the most meaningful photographs are the ones that bring you back to a feeling.

My approach is simple — to document your story naturally, with intention, warmth, and a cinematic touch.

02 / Selected works

A collection of fleeting moments.

Every story is different. Every connection is personal. A few frames from a story told in natural light, movement and genuine affection.

03 / The experience

Come as you are. Let the moments unfold.

You don't have to know how to pose or worry about being perfect. I focus on the little things that make your story yours, offering gentle direction when you need it.

01Natural, never forced.
02Personal, never ordinary.
03Made to be remembered.

05 / Good to know

A few things to know.

How do I enquire about my date?

Reach out via Instagram DM @mdzefry or WhatsApp Business. Share your preferred date, venue and collection, and we'll take it from there.

How many hours are included?

All three wedding collections include up to 8 hours of wedding day coverage. Additional hours are RM150 per hour.

How will we receive our photographs?

Your high-resolution images are shared in a private online gallery for viewing and downloading.

How long does delivery take?

The Moment collection specifies a turnaround of 6–8 weeks. Please enquire about delivery timing for the other collections and albums.

Can we add a pre- or post-wedding session?

Yes. Pre/post-wedding coverage is available as an add-on from RM450+.

06 / Let's tell your story

Before it all becomes a memory — let me be the one to capture it.

Tell me a little about your day. Your story deserves to be remembered.
